author: Angela Latimer
title: Malibu Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb chicken breasts (boneless, skinless, pounded to ½-inch thickness)
tallow (for frying, or use your preferred cooking oil)
1 Tbsp Dijon mustard (Grey Poupon, Maille, or organic Dijon)
1 lb chicken breasts (boneless, skinless, pounded to ½-inch thickness)
tallow (for frying, or use your preferred cooking oil)
1 Tbsp Dijon mustard (Grey Poupon, Maille, or organic Dijon)

instructions_list: Flatten the 1 lb chicken breasts with a meat mallet to an even thickness for quick and even cooking.
Place the pounded chicken in a zip-top bag with the 2 large egg yolks and minced 2 tsp garlic . Massage to coat and refrigerate for 4 hours (or at least 30 minutes) .
Whisk together the ½ cup Panko breadcrumbs , ½ cup plain breadcrumbs , ¼ cup all-purpose flour , ½ cup Parmesan cheese , 1 tsp garlic powder , ½ tsp each, salt & pepper in a shallow dish.
Press the marinated chicken firmly into the breading mixture until thoroughly coated on both sides.
Heat tallow or your preferred high smoke point cooking oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and fry the chicken until golden brown on both sides.
Transfer the seared chicken to a parchment-lined baking sheet and bake at 400°F (205°C/Gas Mark 6) until the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C) .

Combine the ¼ cup mayonnaise , 1 Tbsp Dijon mustard , 1 tsp yellow mustard , 1 tsp honey , ¼ tsp onion powder , and optional ½ tsp lemon juice in a small bowl. Whisk until smooth and chill until serving.
Layer each chicken breast with slices of 2 of the 8 slices thinly-sliced deli ham and 1 of the 4 slices Swiss cheese , then return to the oven for 5 minutes until the cheese is bubbly and melted.
Serve the chicken immediately with a side of the chilled Malibu dipping sauce.
description: Learn how to make the ultimate Malibu Chicken with a unique garlic-egg marinade and a crispy 50/50 panko crust fried in savory tallow. This easy stack and bake method yields juicy chicken topped with salty ham and melty Swiss cheese, served with a signature tangy dipping sauce. It’s the perfect shortcut to a Country Cordon Bleu that the whole family will love.1x recipe yields 4 servings, but it's an easy recipe to double up and feed a crowd!
